children: Our Bureau New Delhi: Logistics company Delhivery reported a 20% year-on-year (YoY) rise in operating revenue at 3,066 crore for the September quarter, led by growth in transport services business. This comprises its ecommerce shipment and part-truck load transportation verticals.

The Gurugram-based company posted a net profit of 41 crore during the three-month period, compared to a 50 crore net loss in the same quarter last year. The turnaround in Delhivery's bottomline was consistent with its improving unit economics over the last few quarters.

In the April-June period, it reported 32 crore in net profit. Express parcel, or the ecommerce shipment business, reported a 32% year-on-year volume growth and a 22% revenue growth during the September quarter. This is Delhivery's biggest business vertical. "Express volumes grew 32% YoY in Q2FY27 and 43% YoY in H1FY27, reflecting continued market share gains and the strength of our value proposition across a broad and diversified customer base.

While it remains early to comment on the remainder of Q3FY27, October volumes have exceeded our initial expectations, providing an encouraging start to Q3," the company said to shareholders. The October-December quarter of 2026 is expected to be a strong period for logistics and ecommerce companies given that most of the festive shopping period falls during these months.

Delhivery said it will focus on four key initiatives to sustain growth through the rest of FY27 and beyond. These include expanding the geographic reach of its same-day and next-day delivery network, deepening adoption of its integrated warehousing and transportation services among ecommerce clients, and broadening its aggregator and franchise partner programmes. The company plans to introduce products and value-added services on Delhivery One and Delhivery Direct to onboard more SMES.

title: Delhivery Extends Profit Streak
